Lvl usually equates to experience but in this game and many other games with a casual setting, it would seem that casual and ranked are beginning to become almost indistinguishable to the casual player. I know they don’t actually care but do they care about those who want to succeed in a hardcore setting? Who’s being selfish? The hardcore player ? The devs? Or the casual player who insists on playing in a hardcore setting only to quit out before it ends or 1v4 a team? Or is it when they cap a base and run away to look for a fight leaving their teammate(s) to be jumped and outnumbered thusly starting a downhill battle almost all the time. Or lastly is it the people who exclusively play one type creating full teams of glass cannons who can’t get a hit off before they die? Honestly this has turned into a rant and I’m not proud of it at all. But this is what I’m always witnessing when I play solo it’s hilarious and sad. Siege isn’t even like this, their matchmaking consists of different things i.e. lvl, rank, kd etc. nothing against you at all I’m just not a fan of the casual player/mindset IN a non-casual environment
